title.zh: 模块格基密钥封装机制标准（FIPS 203）

entries.relatedPolicy: Related entries are distinct concepts; no merge or replacement is implied.

zh.principle: **标准**：模块格基密钥封装机制标准（FIPS 203）（Module-Lattice-Based Key-Encapsulation Mechanism Standard (ML-KEM)）。FIPS 203 自述机制类别：「This standard specifies a set of algorithms for establishing a shared secret key.While there are many methods for establishing a shared secret key, the particular method described in this standard is a key-encapsulation mechanism (KEM).」——它规定的是 KEM 这一类协商方式，而非通用密钥管理。
zh.why: 参数化是为权衡而设：§1.1 写「This standard specifies three parameter sets for ML-KEM that offer different trade-offs in security strength versus performance.」摘要同时给出安全前提与批准范围——「At present, ML-KEM is believed to be secure, even against adversaries who possess a quantum computer.」以及「All three parameter sets of ML-KEM are approved to protect sensitive, non-classified communication systems of the U.S.Federal Government.」
zh.used: 标准名与类别就是它的用途声明写在适用范围：「This standard, or other FIPS or NIST Special Publications that specify alternative mechanisms, shall be used wherever the establishment of a shared secret key … is required for federal applications」。标准名与类别即「Module-Lattice-Based Key-Encapsulation Mechanism Standard (FIPS 203)」与「Computer Security.Subcategory.Cryptography.」。
zh.broken: 两处限度：其一，符合标准不等于系统安全，正文写「the use of a product containing an implementation that conforms to this standard does not guarantee the security of the overall system in which the product is used.」；其二，KEM 的安全保证有条件——「the security guarantees of a KEM only hold under certain conditions」，且豁免空间被关掉——「The Federal Information Security Management Act (FISMA) does not allow for waivers to Federal Information Processing Standards (FIPS) that are made mandatory by the Secretary of Commerce.」
zh.history: 身份与法源在文首成套出现：「Announcing the Module-Lattice-Based Key-Encapsulation Mechanism Standard」为标题行，制定依据写「Federal Information Processing Standards (FIPS) publications are developed by the National Institute of Standards and Technology (NIST) under 15 U.S.C.278g-3 and issued by the Secretary of Commerce under 40 U.S.C.11331.」这是 NIST 后量子标准化产出的 FIPS 之一；本文件自身只在参考文献里列出 CRYSTALS-Kyber 提交件，候选到标准的沿革由 R4 轮的算法与事件条目承载，本文只报文档自身的表述。

en.principle: **Standard**: Module-Lattice-Based Key-Encapsulation Mechanism Standard (ML-KEM) (模块格基密钥封装机制标准（FIPS 203）). FIPS 203 states its mechanism class: "This standard specifies a set of algorithms for establishing a shared secret key. While there are many methods for establishing a shared secret key, the particular method described in this standard is a key-encapsulation mechanism (KEM)." — a KEM, not key management in general.
en.why: Parameterisation exists for trade-offs: §1.1 states "This standard specifies three parameter sets for ML-KEM that offer different trade-offs in security strength versus performance." and fixes both the safety premise and the approval scope — "At present, ML-KEM is believed to be secure, even against adversaries who possess a quantum computer." and "All three parameter sets of ML-KEM are approved to protect sensitive, non-classified communication systems of the U.S. Federal Government."
en.used: The applicability clause is the use statement: "This standard, or other FIPS or NIST Special Publications that specify alternative mechanisms, shall be used wherever the establishment of a shared secret key … is required for federal applications", under the name "Module-Lattice-Based Key-Encapsulation Mechanism Standard (FIPS 203)" and the category line "Computer Security. Subcategory. Cryptography."
en.broken: Two limits: conformance is not system security — "the use of a product containing an implementation that conforms to this standard does not guarantee the security of the overall system in which the product is used." — the qualification clause adds that "the security guarantees of a KEM only hold under certain conditions" — and the waiver door is shut: "The Federal Information Security Management Act (FISMA) does not allow for waivers to Federal Information Processing Standards (FIPS) that are made mandatory by the Secretary of Commerce."
en.history: Identity and legal basis appear together at the head: the announcement line is "Announcing the Module-Lattice-Based Key-Encapsulation Mechanism Standard" and the authority sentence "Federal Information Processing Standards (FIPS) publications are developed by the National Institute of Standards and Technology (NIST) under 15 U.S.C. 278g-3 and issued by the Secretary of Commerce under 40 U.S.C. 11331." This is one of NIST’s post-quantum FIPS publications; the document itself only lists the CRYSTALS-Kyber submission in its references, so the candidate-to-standard lineage is carried by the algorithm and event entries reviewed in round R4 and is noted here as outside this document’s own wording.

Module-Lattice-Based Key-Encapsulation Mechanism Standard (ML-KEM): the registered public parameters, key material or randomness, and message are mapped through the stated transformation to an output checked against the registered criterion. zh: KEM：密钥封装机制，用公钥封装并解出共享密钥。
ML-KEM：模格上的 KEM 构造名。
parameter set：标准给定的三档参数组合。
shared secret key：由 KEM 建立的对称密钥。
non-classified：三档参数获批用于保护敏感但非涉密的通信系统。
waiver：对强制 FIPS 的豁免，FISMA 不允许。
en: KEM: key encapsulation mechanism, wrapping a shared key under a public key.
ML-KEM: the module-lattice KEM construction name.
Parameter set: one of the three configurations the standard gives.
Shared secret key: the symmetric key a KEM establishes.
Non-classified: all three parameter sets are approved for sensitive, non-classified communication systems.
Waiver: relief from a mandatory FIPS, which FISMA does not allow.
